correctness.rationale: For distinct simultaneously feasible marked cycle signatures with fixed deterministic color counts and common θ>0 Ewens weight, choosing disjoint labelled cycles gives normalized covariance F_{a,b}G_{r,s}(θ)−1 with F falling-factorial combinatorics and G=product_{j<=s}(θ+n−j)/(θ+n−r−j). G strictly decreases to 1; F=1 exactly for disjoint color supports, otherwise F<1. This proves positive covariance in disjoint-support case and at most one positive-to-negative crossing otherwise, with the exact F G(0+)>1 test. For (2,1),(1,2) types in balanced n=2m, the exact rational ratio has a unique zero θ_m=m/4+5/4+O(1/m) and Cov/n→γ²(1−8γ)/(64(1+γ)^7) at θ=γn. Independently checked centered Taylor coefficient (20−16c)/(9m²), macroscopic ratio coefficient and 67 monotonicity sequences. Source checker enumerates 41040 finite permutations and exact moments, but the general proof is marked-cycle factorization.
